assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: finished app launcher icon artwork for a Korean calm/rest app named Chabun (the name is context only and MUST NOT appear in the artwork).
Primary request: a beautiful, premium, quiet nighttime icon: one simple warm ivory crescent moon floating over a very still dark blue lake, with a restrained soft reflection and a single smooth horizon. Realistic light and material, almost photographic, carefully simplified into a strong memorable silhouette legible at small sizes. Deep ink navy background, gentle ivory glow, a hint of muted teal in the water.
Composition: square 1024x1024, full bleed artwork to every edge, centered symbol inside middle 60% for an Android adaptive icon. Moon prominent and serene, reflection subtle. Restrained cinematic realism, no shiny plastic look. No outer frame, no perspective app mockup, no rounded square baked into image.
Constraints: absolutely no text, letters, Korean writing, digits, badges, logo typography, watermark or user interface. No extra moons, no clouds crossing the moon, no dense starfield. Deliver one standalone square image, not a collage.

Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: text-free photographic background for a very tall, narrow scene card in a calm rest app.
Primary request: the soothing feeling of an airplane cabin at cruising altitude. Photograph from the window seat of a quiet passenger airplane, an elegant oval cabin window as the main subject slightly above center, looking over a real aircraft wing and a sea of soft clouds at late twilight. A subtle muted mauve-blue sky above clouds; realistic warm low cabin ambient light gently touches the textured ivory window surround and dark upholstered seat edge. Intimate, sheltered, peaceful. No passengers visible.
Composition: one very tall portrait image, requested 1024x2560, central subject all within middle 65% width so it survives narrow card cropping. Window and cloud view strongest in middle vertical 30%-65%; darker, visually quiet upper 20% and lower 25% to support separately rendered app copy. Full bleed scenery, no text or graphic overlays. Realistic proportions of an aircraft cabin and window, natural optical perspective.
Style: premium travel editorial photography, physically plausible lighting, detailed real materials, soft filmic dynamic range, deep charcoal and muted blue with warm neutral highlights, not overly dark, not flashy or oversaturated.
Avoid: any letters, labels, writing, numbers, brands, logos, watermark, UI, infographic, borders, collage, cartoon, illustration, excessive lens flare. Deliver one standalone background.

Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: text-free photographic background for a very tall, narrow scene card in a calm rest app.
Primary request: an utterly peaceful spacewalk, seen through the eyes of a person floating silently in Earth orbit. Breathtaking realistic curved Earth with a thin pale blue atmosphere and softly lit white cloud systems, the limb gently diagonal across the lower middle; deep nearly black indigo space above with a sparse subtle starfield. A small section of a realistically lit white EVA glove enters at the lower right edge as a quiet first-person cue, with no body, faces or helmet dominating. Vastness and weightless calm, restful rather than action-packed. Earth and atmospheric rim are the main subject.
Composition: one very tall portrait image, requested 1024x2560; main luminous atmospheric arc around vertical 45%-60%, within middle 65% width for narrow card crops. Upper 20% deep calm space, lower 25% softly shadowed Earth/clouds and very subtle glove detail, both leave quiet areas for app copy that is added later. Full bleed, no framing.
Style: convincing high-end orbital photography with physically plausible sunlight, detailed but natural Earth clouds, controlled exposure, deep midnight blue palette, subtle cool cyan rim. Beautiful and quietly awe-inspiring, no fantasy nebula.
Constraints: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, space agency emblems, flag patches, logos, spacecraft labels, watermarks, UI, borders or collages. No large astronaut, explosions, spacecraft clutter, giant planets, saturated purple galaxies. One standalone background.

Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: text-free photographic background for a very tall narrow scene card in a calm rest app.
Primary request: a cozy little wooden cabin sheltering in steady rain deep in a real forest at blue hour. View from outside under nearby trees, the cabin warmly illuminated from within through a small window, rain trailing off its dark pitched roof, wet timber texture and fine rain streaks visible naturally in the light. Damp dark leaves, soft distant trees, a little mist and wet earth. Main cabin window glows soft warm amber, no harsh spotlights. Peaceful refuge, intimate and believable, no people.
Composition: one very tall portrait image, requested 1024x2560; compact cabin at middle vertical 40%-65% and within central 65% of width, so the cabin survives very narrow card cropping. Upper 20% quiet shadowy forest canopy; lower 25% dark softly textured wet foreground, suitable behind separately rendered copy. Strongly readable cabin silhouette. Full bleed.
Style: premium cinematic nature photograph, realistic rain and building construction, natural wet wood and moss, subtle depth of field, subdued deep brown, charcoal and evergreen with restrained amber window light. Comfortable, quiet, photoreal, not horror, not fantasy art.
Constraints: no text of any kind, no letters, numbers, signage, logos, watermark, UI, borders or collage; no people, no excessive decorative objects, no neon, no oversaturated orange. One standalone background.

Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: text-free photographic background for a very tall narrow scene card in a calm rest app.
Primary request: a real lush forest just before sunrise, a peaceful view into tall straight trees and soft layers of dawn mist. A narrow moss-lined woodland path runs gently into the center distance. Dim pale morning light filters through distant trees with a few extremely subtle soft shafts, tiny dewdrops on nearby leaves, rich natural fern and moss texture at the sides, soft breathing space in the middle. Crisp fresh air and profound calm, no people, no buildings, no animals.
Composition: one very tall portrait image, requested 1024x2560, principal misty opening and quiet path at vertical middle 35%-65% and central 65% of width to survive narrow card cropping. Upper 20% darker evergreen canopy and trunks; lower 25% muted softly shadowed moss and path to support separately rendered app copy. Full bleed scenery.
Style: very high quality landscape photography, convincing real botanical details and natural atmospheric perspective; restrained forest green, cool jade, misty blue gray and a little pale warm dawn light. Peaceful and detailed but not overprocessed. No fantasy glowing plants.
Constraints: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, signs, logos, watermark, UI, frames or collage. No intense sunburst, overdone god rays, oversaturated green. One standalone background.
